WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') AS page_location,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_title') AS page_title,
    event_timestamp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210102`
  WHERE user_pseudo_id = '1402138.5184246691'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    page_location,
    page_title,
    event_timestamp,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(page_location, r'://[^/]+/(.*)') AS path,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(page_location, r'/([^/]+)$') AS last_segment,
    REGEXP_CONTAINS(REGEXP_EXTRACT(page_location, r'/([^/]+)$'), r'\+') AS last_has_plus,
    REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(REPLACE(REGEXP_EXTRACT(page_location, r'://[^/]+/(.*)'), '+', ' ')), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus\s*collection|drinkware|electronics|google\s*redesign|lifestyle|nest|new\s*2015\s*logo|notebooks\s*journals|office|shop\s+by\s+brand|small\s+goods|stationery|wearables)') AS has_category
  FROM page_views
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  CASE 
    WHEN path = '' OR path IS NULL THEN 'Home'
    WHEN has_category AND last_has_plus THEN 'PDP'
    WHEN has_category AND NOT last_has_plus THEN 'PLP'
    ELSE page_title
  END AS page_name
FROM classified
ORDER BY page_name
